region.dialogDesc: Define inclusion and exclusion areas directly on the live frame. Supports drawing, moving, resizing, and anchor checking.
region.rule1: 1. Uses target bounding box bottom-center point ((x1+x2)/2, y2) as test coordinate.
region.rule2: 2. MASK takes highest precedence: targets inside any MASK are always discarded.
region.rule3: 3. ROI is an allowlist: if configured, only targets inside an ROI are kept. Empty means pass all.
